$comment: Permission catalog for this application, maintained by iGRP Studio. Pushed to Access Management at startup when IGRP_SYNC_PERMISSIONS=true (see docs/PERMISSIONS.md). Names are BARE suffixes: Access Management qualifies them with the department when granting to a role, and the resulting token claim is `${department}.${name}`. A name containing a dot is treated as already department-qualified by the permission gates, so keep suffixes dot-free.
